NEE_CanonicalFrame.source:
import NED_ScannerCohorts
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEE_CanonicalFrame
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP AspisR1AdapterReconstruct
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- The external state is threaded unchanged through the exact emitted
iteration. Native modifies verification independently checks this frame. -/
def body {State : Type} (d : Array U32 8#usize) (p : Usize × State) :
    Result (ControlFlow (Usize × State) (Bool × State)) := do
  let r ← aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical_loop.body d p.1
  match r with
  | .cont i => ok (.cont (i,p.2))
  | .done b => ok (.done (b,p.2))

def run {State : Type} (d : Array U32 8#usize) (state : State) : Result (Bool × State) :=
  loop (body d) (0#usize,state)

/-- Termination/bounds of one emitted step, reused independently of state. -/
theorem step_total (d : Array U32 8#usize) (i : Usize) (bound : i.val ≤ 8) :
    ∃ r, aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical_loop.body d i = ok r ∧
      (match r with
       | .done _ => True
       | .cont j => j.val ≤ 8 ∧ 8-j.val < 8-i.val) := by
  have spec : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical_loop.body d i
      ⦃ r => match r with
        | .done _ => True
        | .cont j => j.val ≤ 8 ∧ 8-j.val < 8-i.val ⦄ := by
    unfold aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical_loop.body
    step*
    all_goals first | trivial | scalar_tac
  exact WP.spec_imp_exists spec

/-- Whole-loop frame by decreasing-index induction, without native unwinding.
No claim about a native state is supplied as a hypothesis. -/
theorem frame {State : Type} (d : Array U32 8#usize) (state : State) :
    ∃ b : Bool, run d state = ok (b,state) := by
  have spec : run d state ⦃ r => r.2 = state ⦄ := by
    unfold run
    refine loop.spec_decr_nat (fun p : Usize × State => 8-p.1.val)
      (fun p : Usize × State => p.1.val ≤ 8 ∧ p.2 = state)
      (fun r : Bool × State => r.2 = state) (body d) (0#usize,state) ?_ ?_
    · intro p hp
      rcases p with ⟨i,σ⟩
      have bound := hp.1
      have same := hp.2
      obtain ⟨r,call,safety⟩ := step_total d i bound
      unfold body
      rw [call]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      cases r with
      | done b =>
        exact same
      | cont j =>
        exact ⟨⟨safety.1,same⟩,safety.2⟩
    · exact ⟨by scalar_tac,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨p,call,same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists spec
  rcases p with ⟨b,σ⟩
  dsimp only at same
  rw [same] at call
  exact ⟨b,call⟩

/-- Both frozen scanner bodies share this state-frame step, including reject
and exhaustion. Their independently checked value inductions are reused. -/
theorem tree_body {State : Type} (d : Array U32 8#usize) (p : Usize × State) :
    body d p = (do
      let r ← aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical_loop.body d p.1
      match r with
      | .cont i => ok (.cont (i,p.2))
      | .done b => ok (.done (b,p.2))) := by rfl

#print axioms step_total
#print axioms frame
#print axioms tree_body
end NEE_CanonicalFrame

import NEJ_ArrayFrame
import NED_CommonEncodeCohort
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEJ_ConcreteFrame
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder

/-- Fixed-array child return widths discharge every copy-window length. -/
theorem array_copy_frame {N W : Usize} (dst : Array U8 N) (src : Array U8 W)
    (start k : Nat) (fits : start + W.val ≤ N.val)
    (outside : k < start ∨ start + W.val ≤ k) :
    (dst.setSlice! start src.val).val[k]? = dst.val[k]? := by
  apply NEJ_ArrayFrame.array_frame
  · simpa only [src.property] using fits
  · simpa only [src.property] using outside

theorem scalar_frame {N : Usize} (dst : Array U8 N) (i : Usize) (v : U8) (k : Nat)
    (different : k ≠ i.val) : (dst.set i v).val[k]? = dst.val[k]? := by
  change (dst.val.set i.val v)[k]? = dst.val[k]?
  exact List.getElem?_set_ne different.symm

/-- All emitted field writes preserve the original reserved byte/suffix.
This theorem quantifies over arbitrary common fields and arbitrary prestate. -/
theorem encoded_frame (out : Array U8 216#usize) (magic : Array U8 4#usize)
    (kind : pool_v1.historical_anchor.PoolV1TransitionKind)
    (c : pool_v1.payment_relation.CommonPublicV1) (k : Nat)
    (outside : k = 7 ∨ 148 ≤ k) :
    (NBP_CommonBytes.encoded out magic kind c).val[k]? = out.val[k]? := by
  simp only [NBP_CommonBytes.encoded, NBP_CommonTail0.expected,
    NBP_CommonTail1.expected, NBP_CommonTail2.expected, NBP_CommonTail3.expected,
    NBP_CommonTail4.expected, NBP_CommonTail5.expected, NBP_CommonTail6.expected]
  rw [array_copy_frame _ _ 144 k (by decide) (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [array_copy_frame _ _ 112 k (by decide) (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [array_copy_frame _ _ 80 k (by decide) (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [array_copy_frame _ _ 72 k (by decide) (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [array_copy_frame _ _ 40 k (by decide) (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [array_copy_frame _ _ 8 k (by decide) (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [scalar_frame _ _ _ k (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [scalar_frame _ _ _ k (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [scalar_frame _ _ _ k (by scalar_tac)]
  exact array_copy_frame out magic 0 k (by decide) (by scalar_tac)

#print axioms array_copy_frame
#print axioms scalar_frame
#print axioms encoded_frame
end NEJ_ConcreteFrame

NEJ_ScannerFramed.source:
import NEE_CanonicalFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEJ_ScannerFramed
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP AspisR1AdapterReconstruct
open NBD_DigestInduction
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- A single loop execution has BOTH the canonicality result and the external
frame. This strengthens the predecessor's existential frame, without assuming
its existential Boolean equals the value of an unrelated execution. -/
theorem value_and_frame {State : Type} (d : Array U32 8#usize) (state : State) :
    NEE_CanonicalFrame.run d state = ok (decide (Canonical d),state) := by
  have spec : NEE_CanonicalFrame.run d state
      ⦃ r => r = (decide (Canonical d),state) ⦄ := by
    unfold NEE_CanonicalFrame.run
    refine loop.spec_decr_nat (fun p : Usize × State => 8-p.1.val)
      (fun p : Usize × State => p.1.val ≤ 8 ∧
        (Canonical d ↔ Suffix d p.1.val) ∧ p.2=state)
      (fun r : Bool × State => r=(decide (Canonical d),state))
      (NEE_CanonicalFrame.body d) (0#usize,state) ?_ ?_
    · intro p hp
      rcases p with ⟨i,σ⟩
      rcases hp with ⟨bound,eqv,same⟩
      dsimp only at bound eqv same
      have raw_spec : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical_loop.body d i
          ⦃ r => match r with
            | .done b => (b,σ)=(decide (Canonical d),state)
            | .cont j => (j.val ≤ 8 ∧ (Canonical d ↔ Suffix d j.val) ∧ σ=state) ∧
                8-j.val < 8-i.val ⦄ := by
        unfold aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical_loop.body
        step*
        all_goals try unfold aspis_core.field.P at *
        all_goals simp_all [Canonical, Suffix]
        all_goals first | scalar_tac | skip
        · refine ⟨⟨i.val, by scalar_tac⟩, Nat.le_refl _, ?_⟩
          assumption
        · refine ⟨by scalar_tac, ?_, by scalar_tac⟩
          constructor
          · intro h j hj
            exact h j (by omega)
          · intro h j hj
            by_cases same : j.val=i.val
            · simpa only [same] using
                (show (d.val[i.val]'(by have := d.property; scalar_tac)).val < 2147483647 from by assumption)
            · exact h j (by omega)
      obtain ⟨r,call,post⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists raw_spec
      unfold NEE_CanonicalFrame.body
      dsimp only
      rw [call]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      cases r with
      | done b => exact post
      | cont j => exact post
    · constructor
      · scalar_tac
      · exact ⟨by simp [Canonical,Suffix],rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r,call,same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists spec
  rw [same] at call
  exact call

#print axioms value_and_frame
end NEJ_ScannerFramed

NEJ_WindowStep.source:
import NEJ_CommonFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEJ_WindowStep
open KMX_CopyMeaning

/-- Value operation of exactly one KMX indexed iteration on a caller window. -/
def step {α : Type} (dst src : Nat → α) (start offset : Nat) : Nat → α :=
  write dst (start+offset) (src offset)

/-- Native step's local source index is the same global destination cell. -/
theorem association {α : Type} (dst src : Nat → α) (start offset : Nat) :
    step dst src start offset =
      write dst (start+offset) ((fun k => src (k-start)) (start+offset)) := by
  simp only [step, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]

/-- Induction covers an arbitrary suffix from the caller-established invariant,
not only an initially zero buffer or a concrete iteration count. -/
theorem iteration {α : Type} (dst src : Nat → α) (start offset count k : Nat) :
    loop (fun j => src (j-start)) dst (start+offset) count k =
      if start+offset ≤ k ∧ k < start+offset+count then src (k-start) else dst k :=
  loop_spec _ _ _ _ _

/-- The remaining copy suffix cannot overwrite an already-written earlier cell. -/
theorem earlier_frame {α : Type} (dst src : Nat → α) (start offset count k : Nat)
    (before : k < start+offset) :
    loop (fun j => src (j-start)) dst (start+offset) count k = dst k :=
  copy_frame _ _ _ _ _ (Or.inl before)

/-- A caller's fixed-array widths give the exact loop termination invariant. -/
theorem bounds (start width offset : Nat) (within : offset < width)
    (fits : start+width ≤ 216) :
    start+offset < 216 ∧ offset+1 ≤ width ∧ width-(offset+1) < width-offset := by
  omega

#print axioms association
#print axioms iteration
#print axioms earlier_frame
#print axioms bounds
end NEJ_WindowStep

import NED_CommonValidation
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEL_CommonOracle
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NBG_PaymentChecks

def value (c : C) (anchor nullifier : Bool) : core.result.Result Unit E :=
  if zero c.pool || zero c.deployment_domain then .Err .ZeroRequiredBinding
  else if c.anchor_sequence.val > 1048576 then .Err .InvalidAnchorSequence
  else if !anchor || !nullifier then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest
  else if c.asset_id.val >= 2147483647 then .Err .NonCanonicalAssetId
  else .Ok ()

def calls (c : C) (anchor : Bool) : List (Array U32 8#usize) :=
  if zero c.pool || zero c.deployment_domain then []
  else if c.anchor_sequence.val > 1048576 then []
  else if !anchor then [c.anchor_root]
  else [c.anchor_root,c.nullifier]

/-- Ruling y part (3): substitute the already closed pure canonicality child.
The native caller's counter records exactly this ordered argument list. -/
theorem substitution (c : C) :
    value c (canonical c.anchor_root) (canonical c.nullifier) = common c := by rfl

theorem reached_argument (c : C) (anchor : Bool) (d : _)
    (reached : d ∈ calls c anchor) : d = c.anchor_root ∨ d = c.nullifier := by
  unfold calls at reached
  repeat' split at reached
  all_goals simp_all

theorem call_count (c : C) (anchor : Bool) : (calls c anchor).length =
    if zero c.pool || zero c.deployment_domain then 0
    else if c.anchor_sequence.val > 1048576 then 0
    else if !anchor then 1 else 2 := by
  unfold calls
  repeat' split
  all_goals rfl

#print axioms substitution
#print axioms reached_argument
#print axioms call_count
end NEL_CommonOracle

import NEL_CopyArrayLaw
import NEL_DigestGeometry
import NBP_DigestEncode
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEL_DigestLoopFrame
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder AspisR1.S2K

/-- Native byte-update observations are associated with the SAME emitted
protocol step, not an independently selected digest or output allocation. -/
theorem step_and_bytes (digest : Array U32 8#usize) (index : Usize)
    (range : index.val < 8) (out : Array U8 32#usize) :
    ∃ next, ∃ after : Array U8 32#usize,
      atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical_loop.body (DigestTotal.cursor digest index) out =
        ok (.cont (next,after)) ∧
      ∀ k : Nat, after.val[k]? =
        KMX_CopyMeaning.loop
          (fun j => (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes
            (digest.val[index.val]'(by have := digest.property; change digest.val.length=8 at this; omega))).val[j-4*index.val]?)
          (fun j => out.val[j]?) (4*index.val) 4 k := by
  refine ⟨_,_,NBP_DigestEncode.step digest index range out,?_⟩
  intro k
  exact (NEL_CopyArrayLaw.loop_binding out
    (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes
      (digest.val[index.val]'(by have := digest.property; change digest.val.length=8 at this; omega)))
    (4*index.val) k (by change 4*index.val+4 ≤ 32; omega)).symm

#print axioms step_and_bytes
end NEL_DigestLoopFrame

import NED_PaymentValidation

namespace NEL_PaymentDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NBG_PaymentChecks NBG_PaymentValidators

theorem common_accepted (c : C) (accepted : common c = .Ok ()) :
    zero c.pool = false ∧ zero c.deployment_domain = false ∧
    c.anchor_sequence.val ≤ 1048576 ∧ canonical c.anchor_root = true ∧
    canonical c.nullifier = true ∧ c.asset_id.val < 2147483647 := by
  unfold common at accepted
  repeat' split at accepted
  all_goals simp_all <;> omega

theorem transfer_accepted (p : T) (accepted : transfer p = .Ok ()) :
    common (tc p) = .Ok () ∧ canonical p.recipient_commitment = true ∧
      canonical p.change_commitment = true := by
  unfold transfer at accepted
  cases hc : common (tc p) with
  | Err e => simp only [hc,reduceCtorEq] at accepted
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    simp only [hc] at accepted
    split at accepted
    · contradiction
    · simp_all

theorem withdrawal_accepted (p : W) (accepted : withdrawal p = .Ok ()) :
    common (wc p) = .Ok () ∧ 0 < p.amount.val ∧ p.amount.val < 1073741824 ∧
      zero p.destination_token_account = false ∧ canonical p.change_commitment = true := by
  unfold withdrawal at accepted
  cases hc : common (wc p) with
  | Err e => simp only [hc,reduceCtorEq] at accepted
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    simp only [hc] at accepted
    repeat' split at accepted
    all_goals simp_all <;> omega

#print axioms common_accepted
#print axioms transfer_accepted
#print axioms withdrawal_accepted
end NEL_PaymentDomains

import NEL_PaymentDomains
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEL_PaymentOracle
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NBG_PaymentChecks NBG_PaymentValidators
abbrev Reply := core.result.Result Unit E

def transfer_value (reply : Reply) (recipient change : Bool) : Reply :=
  match reply with
  | .Err e => .Err e
  | .Ok () => if !recipient || !change then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else .Ok ()

def withdrawal_value (p : W) (reply : Reply) (change : Bool) : Reply :=
  match reply with
  | .Err e => .Err e
  | .Ok () => if p.amount.val = 0 ∨ p.amount.val >= 1073741824 then .Err .InvalidWithdrawalAmount
      else if zero p.destination_token_account then .Err .InvalidDestination
      else if !change then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else .Ok ()

theorem transfer_substitution (p : T) :
    transfer_value (common (tc p)) (canonical p.recipient_commitment)
      (canonical p.change_commitment) = transfer p := by rfl

theorem withdrawal_substitution (p : W) :
    withdrawal_value p (common (wc p)) (canonical p.change_commitment) = withdrawal p := by rfl

def transfer_calls (reply : Reply) (recipient : Bool) : List Nat :=
  match reply with
  | .Err _ => [0]
  | .Ok () => if !recipient then [0,1] else [0,1,2]

def withdrawal_calls (p : W) (reply : Reply) : List Nat :=
  match reply with
  | .Err _ => [0]
  | .Ok () => if p.amount.val = 0 ∨ p.amount.val >= 1073741824 then [0]
      else if zero p.destination_token_account then [0] else [0,1]

theorem transfer_call_count (reply : Reply) (recipient : Bool) :
    (transfer_calls reply recipient).length =
      match reply with | .Err _ => 1 | .Ok () => if !recipient then 2 else 3 := by
  cases reply with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok u => cases u; cases recipient <;> rfl

theorem withdrawal_call_count (p : W) (reply : Reply) :
    (withdrawal_calls p reply).length =
      (match reply with
       | .Err _ => 1
       | .Ok () =>
         if p.amount.val = 0 ∨ p.amount.val >= 1073741824 then 1
         else if zero p.destination_token_account then 1 else 2) := by
  cases reply with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    by_cases bad : p.amount.val = 0 ∨ p.amount.val >= 1073741824 <;>
      by_cases dest : zero p.destination_token_account = true <;>
        simp [withdrawal_calls,bad,dest]

#print axioms transfer_substitution
#print axioms withdrawal_substitution
#print axioms transfer_call_count
#print axioms withdrawal_call_count
end NEL_PaymentOracle

byte-step theorem. No independently selected index or word is a premise. -/

at the same raw digest; arbitrary external state is preserved by this pure call. -/

       state) = (ok (DigestBytes.bytes d),state) := by
  rw [NED_DigestCohorts.digest_encode, DigestBytes.exact]

end NEM_DigestInstance

theorem frontier_next (rows : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 20#usize)
    (i : Usize) (bound : i.val < 20) :
    LoopStep.next (Iterator.cursor rows i) = ok
      (some (i,rows.val[i.val]'(by have := rows.property; change rows.val.length=20 at this; omega)),
       Iterator.cursor rows (Usize.ofNatCore (i.val+1) (by scalar_tac))) :=
  Iterator.next_row rows i bound

/-- The same emitted native iteration, actual node, arbitrary original slice,
and exact global byte frame. No independently selected child buffer occurs. -/
theorem live_step_and_bytes (rows : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 20#usize)
    (i : Usize) (bound : i.val < 20) (out : Slice U8) (size : out.length = 800) :
    ∃ next, ∃ after : Slice U8,
      NBK_LiveStep.body (Iterator.cursor rows i) out = ok (.cont (next,after)) ∧
      ∀ k : Nat, after.val[k]? = KMX_CopyMeaning.loop
        (fun j => (DigestBytes.bytes
          (rows.val[i.val]'(by have := rows.property; change rows.val.length=20 at this; omega))).val[j-(160+32*i.val)]?)
        (fun j => out.val[j]?) (160+32*i.val) 32 k := by
  let node := rows.val[i.val]'(by have := rows.property; change rows.val.length=20 at this; omega)
  refine ⟨_,_,NBK_LiveStep.body_write _ _ out i node (DigestBytes.bytes node)
    (Iterator.next_row rows i bound) bound size (DigestBytes.exact node),?_⟩
  intro k
  have len : (DigestBytes.bytes node).to_slice.length = 32 := (DigestBytes.bytes node).property
  have fits : 160+32*i.val+32 ≤ out.length := by rw [size]; omega
  have same := (NEL_SliceCopyLaw.loop_binding out (DigestBytes.bytes node).to_slice
    (160+32*i.val) k (by rw [len]; exact fits)).symm
  rw [len] at same
  simpa only [Array.to_slice] using same

theorem after_step_and_bytes (rows : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 20#usize)
    (i : Usize) (bound : i.val < 20) (out : Array U8 688#usize) :
    ∃ next, ∃ after : Array U8 688#usize,
      LoopStep.body (Iterator.cursor rows i) out = ok (.cont (next,after)) ∧

        (fun j => (DigestBytes.bytes
          (rows.val[i.val]'(by have := rows.property; change rows.val.length=20 at this; omega))).val[j-(48+32*i.val)]?)
        (fun j => out.val[j]?) (48+32*i.val) 32 k := by
  let node := rows.val[i.val]'(by have := rows.property; change rows.val.length=20 at this; omega)
  refine ⟨_,_,LoopStep.body_write _ _ out i node (DigestBytes.bytes node)
    (Iterator.next_row rows i bound) bound (DigestBytes.exact node),?_⟩
  intro k
  exact (NEL_CopyArrayLaw.loop_binding out (DigestBytes.bytes node)
    (48+32*i.val) k (by change 48+32*i.val+32 ≤ 688; omega)).symm

def write (before : Nat → U8) (value : U8) (j : Nat) : U8 :=
  if j=5 then value else before j

/-- Actual enclosing encoder's SAME variant tag, with the complete scalar-write frame. -/
theorem statement_window (s : Statement) (before : Nat → U8) (j : Nat) :
    write before (NBN_EncoderBytes.tag s) j =
      if j=5 then (match s with | .PrivateTransfer _ _ => 1#u8 | .Withdrawal _ _ => 2#u8)
      else before j := by
  rw [NBN_U05.encoder_kind]
  rfl

/-- A payment carrier keeps its SAME public value and variant when joined to any common carrier. -/
def join (c : NBD_TerminalProjection.Common)
    (p : Sum NBN_ValidatorSummary.Transfer NBN_ValidatorSummary.Withdrawal) : Statement :=
  match p with | .inl t => .PrivateTransfer c t | .inr w => .Withdrawal c w

theorem payment_window (c : NBD_TerminalProjection.Common)
    (p : Sum NBN_ValidatorSummary.Transfer NBN_ValidatorSummary.Withdrawal)
    (before : Nat → U8) (j : Nat) :
    write before (NBN_EncoderBytes.tag (join c p)) j =
      if j=5 then (match p with | .inl _ => 1#u8 | .inr _ => 2#u8) else before j := by
  cases p <;> exact statement_window _ before j

/-- The caller supplies this SAME header byte. Both valid and every invalid byte preserve state. -/
theorem parser_result_frame {State : Type} (header : Nat → U8) (state : State) :
    (pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.transition_kind (header 5),state) =
      (ok (NBD_TerminalProjection.kind (header 5)),state) := by
  rw [NBD_TerminalProjection.source_kind]

namespace NEQ_LateBorrow
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- The actual emitted borrow and its back function, on the same allocation.
The poststate is arbitrary: this is not a one-cell mutation restriction. -/
theorem rejoin (out : Slice U8) (size : out.length = 1880) :
    ∃ child back,
      core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)
        out {start := 144#usize, «end» := 1664#usize} = ok (child,back) ∧
      child.length = 1520 ∧ ∀ post : Slice U8, back post = out.setSlice! 144 post.val := by
  have guard : (144#usize) ≤ 1664#usize ∧ (1664#usize).val ≤ out.length := by
    constructor
    · decide
    · rw [size]; decide
  simp only [core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut,if_pos guard]
  refine ⟨_,_,rfl,?_,?_⟩
  · have len : out.val.length = 1880 := size
    simp only [Slice.length,List.slice,List.length_take,List.length_drop,len]
    decide
  · intro post
    rfl

/-- All possible 1520-byte child poststates and every external allocation byte. -/
theorem poststate (out post : Slice U8) (size : out.length = 1880)
    (post_size : post.length = 1520) (k : Nat) :
    (out.setSlice! 144 post.val).val[k]? =
      if 144 ≤ k ∧ k < 1664 then post.val[k-144]? else out.val[k]? := by
  rw [← NEL_SliceCopyLaw.loop_binding out post 144 k (by rw [post_size,size]; decide)]
  rw [KMX_CopyMeaning.loop_spec,post_size]

/-- The later afterstate write preserves the exact child's whole poststate. -/
theorem after_preserves_child (out post : Slice U8) (size : out.length = 1880)
    (after : Array U8 216#usize) (k : Nat) (earlier : k < 1664) :
    ((out.setSlice! 144 post.val).setSlice! 1664 after.val).val[k]? =
      (out.setSlice! 144 post.val).val[k]? := by
  apply NEJ_ArrayFrame.list_frame
  · have len : out.val.length = 1880 := size
    simp only [Slice.setSlice!,List.length_setSlice!,after.property,len]
    decide
  · exact Or.inl earlier

#print axioms rejoin
#print axioms poststate
#print axioms after_preserves_child
end NEQ_LateBorrow

import NEQ_LateBorrow
import NEM_ArraySnapshotView
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEQ_RootFrame
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem cover (post : Slice U8) (size : post.length = 1520) :
    ∃ array : Array U8 1520#usize, array.to_slice = post := by
  refine ⟨⟨post.val,size⟩,?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

/-- Every earlier header copy preserves the SAME child's initial window. -/
theorem header_frame (src before : Nat → Option U8) (start width j : Nat)
    (ends : start+width ≤ 144) (later : 144 ≤ j) :
    KMX_CopyMeaning.loop src before start width j = before j := by
  rw [KMX_CopyMeaning.loop_spec]
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]

theorem scalar_frame (before : Nat → Option U8) (value : U8) (start j : Nat)
    (earlier : start < 144) (later : 144 ≤ j) :
    (if j=start then some value else before j) = before j := by
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]

/-- The entire arbitrary late poststate precedes one disjoint payment window. -/
theorem finish (before : Nat → Option U8) (late : Array U8 1520#usize)
    (pay : Array U8 216#usize) (j : Nat) :
    KMX_CopyMeaning.loop (fun k => pay.val[k-1664]?)
      (fun k => if 144 ≤ k ∧ k < 1664 then late.val[k-144]? else before k)
      1664 216 j =
      if 1664 ≤ j ∧ j < 1880 then pay.val[j-1664]?
      else if 144 ≤ j ∧ j < 1664 then late.val[j-144]? else before j := by
  rw [KMX_CopyMeaning.loop_spec]

/-- Complete successful bytes are the same three contiguous source regions. -/
theorem assembled (headBytes : List U8) (plen : headBytes.length = 144)
    (late : Array U8 1520#usize) (pay : Array U8 216#usize)
    (j : Nat) (bound : j < 1880) :
    KMX_CopyMeaning.loop (fun k => pay.val[k-1664]?)
      (fun k => if 144 ≤ k ∧ k < 1664 then late.val[k-144]? else headBytes[k]?)
      1664 216 j = ((headBytes ++ late.val) ++ pay.val)[j]? := by
  rw [finish]
  have llen : late.val.length = 1520 := late.property
  have total : (headBytes ++ late.val).length = 1664 := by
    rw [List.length_append,plen,llen]
  by_cases first : j < 144
  · rw [if_neg (by omega),if_neg (by omega)]
    rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega),List.getElem?_append_left (by omega)]
  · by_cases middle : j < 1664
    · rw [if_neg (by omega),if_pos (by omega)]
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega),List.getElem?_append_right (by omega),plen]
    · rw [if_pos (by omega),List.getElem?_append_right (by omega),total]

/-- Pointwise arbitrary-index observations identify the complete typed result. -/
theorem array_ext (a b : Array U8 1880#usize)
    (same : ∀ j : Nat, a.val[j]? = b.val[j]?) : a = b := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact List.ext_getElem? same

#print axioms cover
#print axioms header_frame
#print axioms scalar_frame
#print axioms finish
#print axioms assembled
#print axioms array_ext
end NEQ_RootFrame

  change (AspisS6FullForestEncoderNamed.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC.val ++
    [AspisS6FullForestEncoderNamed.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_VERSION,

    c.master_account.val ++ c.checkpoint_account.val ++ c.selected_lane_account.val ++

  simp only [List.length_append,List.length_cons,List.length_nil,magic,m,q,l,seq,a]

import S2K_AfterstateEncoding

/-! Success inversion through the actual late-public encoder, preserving the
SAME candidate. Child encoders remain opaque; no call success is postulated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.LateAdmission
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open pool_v1.pair_tree_profile pool_v1.pair_terminal

elab "s2k_unpair" : tactic =>
  Lean.Elab.Tactic.liftMetaTactic fun goal => goal.withContext do
    for decl in ← Lean.getLCtx do
      let type ← Lean.Meta.whnf decl.type
      if type.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 then
        return (← goal.cases decl.fvarId).toList.map (·.mvarId)
    throwError "no product variable"

elab "s2k_uncase" : tactic =>
  Lean.Elab.Tactic.liftMetaTactic fun goal => goal.withContext do
    for decl in ← Lean.getLCtx do
      let type ← Lean.Meta.whnf decl.type
      if type.isAppOfArity ``core.result.Result 2 ||
          type.isAppOfArity ``core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow 2 ||
          type.isConstOf ``core.convert.Infallible then
        return (← goal.cases decl.fvarId).toList.map (·.mvarId)
    throwError "no result/control-flow variable"

theorem candidate (s : PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) (before after : Slice U8)
    (h : encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 s before = ok (.Ok (),after)) :
    ∃ bytes, encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 s.candidate_afterstate = ok (.Ok bytes) := by
  unfold encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 at h
  simp only [Bind.bind, Aeneas.Std.bind, core.result.Result.map_err,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
    core.convert.FromSame.from] at h
  repeat' first
    | (solve | exact ⟨_,by assumption⟩)
    | (solve | exact ⟨_,rfl⟩)
    | (solve | cases h)
    | (dsimp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at h)
    | (s2k_unpair <;> simp_all only [Result.ok.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq])
    | (s2k_uncase <;> simp_all only [Result.ok.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq])
    | (split at h)

theorem validated (s : PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) (before after : Slice U8)
    (h : encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 s before = ok (.Ok (),after)) :
    validate_verified_afterstate s.candidate_afterstate = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  obtain ⟨bytes,run⟩ := candidate s before after h
  have status := AfterstateStatus.status_exact s.candidate_afterstate
  rw [run] at status
  exact status.symm

theorem payload (s : PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) (before after : Slice U8)
    (h : encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 s before = ok (.Ok (),after)) :
    encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 s.candidate_afterstate =
      ok (.Ok (AfterstateEncoding.bytes s.candidate_afterstate)) :=
  AfterstateEncoding.encode_exact _ (validated s before after h)

syscall suffix, not an installed whole-native-emitter child. Validation and
native caller reachability must still precede this cut. -/

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.ResultEvent

def emitFields {A E : Type} (syscall : State A E → List U8 → Result (State A E))
    (state : State A E) (master selected nullifier : Array U8 32#usize)
    (kind lane : U8) (afterstate : Array U8 688#usize) := do
  let out ← S2K_ResultBytes.S2K_reference_bytes master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate
  syscall state out.val

    (syscall : State A E → List U8 → Result (State A E))
    (runtime : RuntimePremise syscall) (state : State A E)
    (master selected nullifier : Array U8 32#usize)
    (kind lane : U8) (afterstate : Array U8 688#usize) :
    let out := ResultEncoding.stores (Array.repeat 792#usize 0#u8)
      master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate
    emitFields syscall state master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate = ok (set state out.val) ∧
    out.val.length = 792 ∧ out.val ≠ [] ∧
    (set state out.val).accounts = state.accounts ∧
    (set state out.val).events = state.events ++ [.setReturnData out.val] := by
  dsimp only
  let out := ResultEncoding.stores (Array.repeat 792#usize 0#u8)
    master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate
  have width : out.val.length = 792 := out.property
  have event := nonempty_event syscall runtime state out.val width
  refine ⟨?_,width,event.2.1,event.2.2.1,event.2.2.2⟩
  unfold emitFields
  rw [ResultEncoding.source_value]
  exact event.1

import NBN_ResultDependency

namespace NEQ_ResultValidator
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Record := NBN_ResultValidator.Record
abbrev Lane := NEE_ValidatorMutation.Lane
abbrev After := NEM_LateOracle.After
inductive Call where
  | lane (d : Array U32 8#usize)
  | after (a : NBH_Validators.Afterstate)

def afterStep (after : After) (r : Record) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit NBN_StatementResult.Error) × List Call :=
  let result := do
    let a ← after r.verified_afterstate
    match a with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Afterstate e))
    | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok ())
  (result,[.after r.verified_afterstate])

def run (lane : Lane) (after : After) (r : Record) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit NBN_StatementResult.Error) × List Call :=
  if r.master_account = zero ∨ r.selected_lane_account = zero then (ok (.Err .NonZeroBinding),[])
  else match lane r.nullifier with
    | .fail e => (.fail e,[.lane r.nullifier])
    | .div => (.div,[.lane r.nullifier])
    | .ok (.Err e) => (ok (.Err (.Account e)),[.lane r.nullifier])
    | .ok (.Ok l) =>
      if r.output_lane ≠ l then (ok (.Err .OutputLaneMismatch),[.lane r.nullifier])
      else ((afterStep after r).1,.lane r.nullifier :: (afterStep after r).2)

def nativeAfter : After := pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1

theorem result (r : Record) :
    (run NEM_LaneReached.lane nativeAfter r).1 =
      pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_result r := by
  rw [NBN_ResultValidator.source]
  unfold run afterStep NBN_ResultValidator.status nativeAfter NEM_LaneReached.lane
  rw [NBN_OutputLane.source]
  by_cases h : r.master_account = zero ∨ r.selected_lane_account = zero
  · simp only [h,if_true]
  · simp only [h,if_false]
    cases hl : NBN_OutputLane.result r.nullifier with
    | Err e => rfl
    | Ok l =>
      dsimp only
      by_cases mismatch : r.output_lane ≠ l
      · simp only [if_pos mismatch]
      · simp only [if_neg mismatch]
        rw [NBK_AfterstateResult.source]
        cases ha : NBH_Validators.afterResult r.verified_afterstate <;> rfl

theorem call_shape (lane : Lane) (after : After) (r : Record) :
    (run lane after r).2 = [] ∨
    (run lane after r).2 = [.lane r.nullifier] ∨
    (run lane after r).2 = [.lane r.nullifier,.after r.verified_afterstate] := by
  unfold run
  split
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · cases h : lane r.nullifier with
    | fail e => exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    | div => exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    | ok status => cases status with
      | Err e => exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
      | Ok l =>
        dsimp only
        by_cases mismatch : r.output_lane ≠ l
        · simp only [if_pos mismatch,or_true,true_or]
        · try simp only [if_neg mismatch]
          exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)

theorem lane_domain (lane : Lane) (after : After) (r : Record) (d : Array U32 8#usize)
    (reached : Call.lane d ∈ (run lane after r).2) : d=r.nullifier := by
  rcases call_shape lane after r with a | b | c <;>
    simp_all only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,reduceCtorEq,false_or,or_false,Call.lane.injEq]

theorem after_domain (lane : Lane) (after : After) (r : Record) (a : NBH_Validators.Afterstate)
    (reached : Call.after a ∈ (run lane after r).2) : a=r.verified_afterstate := by
  rcases call_shape lane after r with x | y | z <;>
    simp_all only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,reduceCtorEq,false_or,or_false,Call.after.injEq]

def effects (r : Record) : List Call :=
  if r.master_account = zero ∨ r.selected_lane_account = zero then []
  else match NBN_OutputLane.result r.nullifier with
    | .Err _ => [.lane r.nullifier]
    | .Ok l => if r.output_lane ≠ l then [.lane r.nullifier]
      else [.lane r.nullifier,.after r.verified_afterstate]

theorem ordered_effects (r : Record) :
    (run NEM_LaneReached.lane nativeAfter r).2 = effects r := by
  unfold run effects NEM_LaneReached.lane
  rw [NBN_OutputLane.source]
  by_cases h : r.master_account = zero ∨ r.selected_lane_account = zero
  · simp only [h,if_true]
  · simp only [h,if_false]
    cases NBN_OutputLane.result r.nullifier with
    | Err e => rfl
    | Ok l =>
      dsimp only
      by_cases mismatch : r.output_lane ≠ l
      · simp only [if_pos mismatch]
      · simp only [if_neg mismatch];rfl

theorem result_state_effects {State : Type} (r : Record) (state : State) :
    let observed := run NEM_LaneReached.lane nativeAfter r
    (observed.1,state,observed.2) =
      (pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_result r,state,effects r) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [result,ordered_effects]
